desc: A feat in firearm engineering that simply must be felt to be believed, the Q4 Steel Frame will surpass all expectations with its unrivaled accuracy and performance. Its steel frame precision machined from solid steel billet improves ergonomics with a wrap-around grip panel, extended beavertail, full length picatinny rail and recessed slide release. The weight distribution of the steel frame drastically reduces recoil to improve shooter performance, ultimately contributing to overall efficiency. A testament to Walther's enduring legacy of excellence, the Q4 Steel Frame delivers peak performance when you need it most. Featuring Walther's legendary barrel, LPA sights as well as front and rear serrations, plus the option for optics for when the situation demands it. The advantages this handgun delivers are undeniable. The Q4 Steel Frame from Walther is an accomplishment that encompasses everything shooters desire in a premier concealed carry firearm capable of outlasting even the toughest conditions.
